name: MHERO I
shortDescription: A flagship off-road SUV built for uncompromising power, presence, and precision engineering.
overview: MHERO I redefines the full-size SUV, pairing a monocoque-reinforced body with a dual-motor architecture engineered for extreme terrain and everyday refinement alike. Every surface is designed to signal capability without sacrificing comfort.
features: Adaptive air suspension with 5 terrain modes
safety: Active lane centering and blind-spot monitoring
Automatic emergency braking with pedestrian detection
interior: Nappa leather and open-pore wood trim
Heated, ventilated, and massaging front seats

detailPage.heroSubcopy: Experience the era of a new icon. MHERO I merges the whispers of electric power with the roars of unparalleled all-terrain performance.
detailPage.exteriorImageLabel: MHERO I parked in front of modern architecture

designGallery.imageLabel: MHERO I front three-quarter on the road
designGallery.heading: Making a Bold Entrance
designGallery.body: The commanding vehicle front is complemented by numerous edges and corners, as well as prominent air intakes on the hood. Striking LED headlights, adorned with a band of light, amplify the bold presence.

designGallery.heading: A Departure With Presence
designGallery.body: Edgy and functional, the MHERO I's rear design captivates with its prominent vertically stacked taillights and rearward-extending trunk extension, adding an additional 20 litres of cargo space.

highlights.title: Front & Rear Sunroof
highlights.body: Two sunroofs flood the cabin with natural light, and close on demand to cut glare and keep the cabin cool in every season.

highlights.title: Signature Light Bar
highlights.body: Striking LED headlights, adorned with a band of light, amplify the bold presence and make MHERO I unmistakable after dark.

highlights.title: Adaptive Grille Shutters
highlights.body: Aerodynamic active grille shutters open and close automatically to balance cooling and efficiency across every terrain.

highlights.imageLabel: MHERO I forged alloy wheel detail
highlights.title: 22" Forged Alloy Wheels
highlights.body: Forged for strength and finished for presence, the 22-inch alloy wheels are built to handle everything from tarmac to trail.

terrainItems.title: Tougher Than Granite
terrainItems.body: The MHERO I excels beyond paved roads, setting new standards in off-road performance. Its rugged design ensures exceptional capability even in the toughest terrains, making every adventure an exhilarating experience.

terrainItems.title: Unstoppable Traction
terrainItems.body: The MHERO I is equipped with three differential locks. In challenging terrain, these locks ensure continuous traction for each wheel, guaranteeing the relentless progress of the MHERO I.

terrainItems.title: Rear Wheel Intelligent Driving
terrainItems.body: With a minimum turning radius of 5.1 meters, the Rear Wheel Steering Assistance offers exceptional agility, making the MHERO I maneuverable in tight spaces and urban environments, despite its size.

terrainItems.title: Crab Moving Mode
terrainItems.body: Crab Moving Mode synchronizes the rear wheels with the front ones, allowing diagonal movement at low speeds, up to 10.6°. This feature enables the MHERO I to effortlessly navigate off-road trails or maneuver with ease in parking situations.

detailPage.cabinIntro: The interior of the MHERO I ensures that all passengers have their needs met. The thoughtfully designed cockpit, equipped with unique design highlights and full connectivity, empowers the driver to navigate safely across diverse routes and terrains.

cabinTabs.label: Premium Cockpit
cabinTabs.heading: Premium Cockpit
cabinTabs.body: Experience the epitome of luxury in the MHERO I's premium cockpit. Crafted with fine wood, satin-finished steel, and sumptuous leather, every detail exudes sophistication. The intelligent interactive cockpit features a multifunctional gear and driving mode selector, reminiscent of a private jet.

cabinTabs.label: Multimedia
cabinTabs.heading: Multimedia
cabinTabs.body: A central infotainment display keeps the driver connected with navigation, media, and vehicle settings at a glance, paired with an immersive sound system tuned for the cabin.

cabinTabs.label: Driving Assistance
cabinTabs.heading: Driving Assistance
cabinTabs.body: An array of driving assistance systems supports the driver across diverse routes and terrains, from lane monitoring to surround-view cameras.

cabinTabs.label: Comfort & Climate
cabinTabs.heading: Comfort & Climate
cabinTabs.body: Intelligent climate control and active noise cancellation keep passengers comfortable throughout the journey, whatever the terrain outside.

cabinTabs.label: Rear Seat Amenities
cabinTabs.heading: Rear Seat Amenities
cabinTabs.body: Rear passengers enjoy generous space, dedicated climate zones, and a front and rear sunroof that floods the cabin with natural light.

cabinTabs.label: 40-20-40 Split
cabinTabs.heading: 40-20-40 Split
cabinTabs.body: A versatile 40-20-40 split rear bench folds to suit passengers, cargo, or both — adapting the cabin to whatever the journey demands.

detailPage.utilityIntro: The MHERO I embodies versatility and utility as a dependable 5-seater, offering impressive payload and roof load capacity, towing capability, and generous luggage volume.
detailPage.chargingBody: The MHERO I Hybrid model can use both fuel and electricity, with a comprehensive range of 834 km. There's no range anxiety for long-distance driving — maximum grade ability reaches 100%, making off-road climbing easier. Maximum torque of 1,050 Nm surpasses other models in its class, making it easier to get out of a trap. The extended-range model uses CATL battery cells, with a pure electric range of 176 km.
detailPage.chargingImageLabel: MHERO I charging at a public station

name: MHERO II - Prime
shortDescription: A performance-luxury sedan engineered for effortless power delivery and everyday sophistication.
overview: MHERO II blends aerodynamic elegance with a high-density battery platform, delivering effortless acceleration and a serene, tech-forward cabin built for the modern executive.
features: Executive rear seating with recline function
safety: Automatic emergency braking with cyclist detection
interior: Vegan leather and brushed aluminium trim
Heated and ventilated front and rear seats

detailPage.heroHeadline: Make The City Play By Your Rules
detailPage.heroSubcopy: MHERO II brings untamed power into the city, with intelligent capability that adapts on demand, bold design that makes its presence known, and a drive not limited to any road.

exteriorItems.body: From a power-retractable side step to a roof rack, every detail is ready for what the day brings.
exteriorItems.imageLabel: MHERO II power-retractable side step and roof rack

interiorItems.title: Cabin Layout
interiorItems.body: The MHERO II interior feels open, quiet, and well organised. A panoramic sunroof, soft-close doors, and full-cabin sound insulation add to the sense of comfort and control.

interiorItems.title: Seating Design
interiorItems.body: Power-adjustable front seats, memory, heating, ventilation, and massage functions make every drive more comfortable for both driver and passenger.

interiorItems.title: Materials & Finishes
interiorItems.body: With 91.2% soft-touch coverage and available Nappa leather, the interior feels refined from the first touch.
interiorItems.imageLabel: MHERO II Nappa leather and soft-touch finishes

interiorItems.title: Driver Cockpit & Displays
interiorItems.body: The 10.25-inch digital instrument cluster and 15.6-inch central touchscreen give the driver clear access to key information, controls, and connectivity in a setup that feels modern and easy to use.
interiorItems.imageLabel: MHERO II digital instrument cluster and touchscreen

detailPage.cabinIntro: The moment you step inside the MHERO II, the focus shifts to the driver's interface. The cabin is defined by a high-tactility layout that features customisable flight buttons and a gear selector inspired by dive-watch aesthetics.

cabinTabs.label: Cabin Layout
cabinTabs.heading: Cabin Layout
cabinTabs.body: The MHERO II interior feels open, quiet, and well organised. A panoramic sunroof, soft-close doors, and full-cabin sound insulation add to the sense of comfort and control.

cabinTabs.label: Seating Design
cabinTabs.heading: Seating Design
cabinTabs.body: Sculpted front seats and a spacious five-seat layout keep every passenger supported and comfortable, whether commuting or covering longer distances.

cabinTabs.label: Materials & Finishes
cabinTabs.heading: Materials & Finishes
cabinTabs.body: Premium finishes and satin-textured surfaces run throughout the cabin, giving MHERO II an interior that feels every bit as considered as its exterior.

cabinTabs.label: Driver Cockpit & Displays
cabinTabs.heading: Driver Cockpit & Displays
cabinTabs.body: A digital cockpit with customisable flight buttons and a dive-watch-inspired gear selector puts total command of the drive at the driver's fingertips.

detailPage.utilityIntro: MHERO II brings together performance, capability, and everyday usability in one place, with ground clearance and wading depth that keep pace wherever the road leads.
detailPage.chargingBody: Whether it's a quick stop or time to recharge fully, the process fits naturally into the journey. From 20% to 80% in just 15 minutes, or a full charge in 4.3 hours, the 31.7 kWh battery uses an EU CCS2 compatible charging port to keep every drive moving without interruption.
